about: The expedition camp's habitat on Mars as the game draws it beyond its kit: Mars's planned ground out to the plan's edge and the ball under it, the furniture CampRooms stands in the domes, the grounds round it (their own stage), the six dome lamps, the mast's beacon, the sun and the sky. Frame: the CampHabitat node's own (0.55 m over the ground under the camp seat, turned -130.5 degrees).

places.name: grounds
places.from: expedition_camp.gd LAYOUT on the camp seat; the habitat stands 0.55 m over the ground there (0.4769 m over the seat's level), turned -130.5 degrees (camp_habitat.gd:318-327)

places.name: camp_airlock
places.from: camp_habitat.gd:88-117,168-185 (the airlock out along the doorway at -40.5 degrees, 10.55 m from the door dome's middle), expedition_camp.gd:208-210,330-333,671-701 (set down 0.3 m over the ground there, turned to the ground's facing with its along kept along the seat), in this frame through the habitat's own set-down (0.55 m, turned -130.5 degrees): the Moon's airlock stage stands in for the camp's, a room of the same 4 m by 5 m shell (camp_airlock.gd:1-13), which the game draws in the shell's code look with boxes for its doors and locker

leave_out.why: the Moon airlock's ramp, laid from its outer door's sill down to the Moon's flat ground (airlock.tscn:27-33, airlock.gd:18-24,70-87); the camp's airlock brings no such ramp and lays its own ramp and footing for Mars's ground (camp_airlock.gd:1-13,63-96, its game/world/mars/expedition_camp/camp_airlock/CLAUDE.md: the Moon's scene brings a plug post and a flat-ground ramp that do not belong here), which this record draws (camp_airlock_ramp, camp_airlock_footing); the two ramps stood in the same box

places.name: camp_tube
places.from: camp_habitat.gd:113-117,168-172 (LinkTube.join from the lining's doorway to the airlock's inner door), link_tube.gd:137-160, tube_kit.gd:26-46: the way between them is 3.26 m long, three bays as the 4.35 m tube stage has, so that stage is shown at 0.749 of its length along its run; the game bends it in a shallow S of under 8 cm off the straight line, laid straight here, and its end pieces are squashed with it

lights.from: camp_mast.gd:26-140 beacon (mast at camp seat (10, -10), light 11.4 m up)

game/world/sky/sky.gd:87,296-307,339-343 (SUN_ENERGY 1.25, the true Sun's way at full strength over 3 degrees up on Mars); its way as the game's camp shots set it, tools/perf/place.gd:223-226,653-675 (_bring_the_camp_sun: the clock run on in 5-minute steps from the run's start until the Sun stands 35 to 50 degrees over the camp and is going down), worked out from sim/engine/space/orbits/orbits.gd (centre_at, facing_at, MARS_LEAD_AT_START 48.2 degrees, the Sun's pull from Earth's 14,400-minute year, Mars's sol of 72,000 ticks, sim/engine/world/pace.gd) and FirstExpedition.CAMP_FACING_OUT: from minute 0 it is minute 8,630, the Sun 49.95 degrees up, going down 0.016 degrees a minute; turned into the habitat's frame

environment.from: sky.gd:161 (background Palette.SPACE, as everywhere), sky.gd:345 (ambient), mars.gd:31-36 (the butterscotch sky is Mars's air, the fog volume in `haze`, seen against space)

haze.from: game/world/mars/mars.gd:31-37,105-116 (the Air FogVolume: an ellipsoid (Worlds.RADIUS 220 + AIR_HEIGHT 70) x 2 across round Mars's middle, Palette.MARS_HAZE #d9a066, AIR_DENSITY 0.012), game/world/sky/sky.gd:50,56,314-319 (worked out 160 m out, thrown forward 0.5)

stars.from: game/world/sky/sky.gd:19-33,517-544 (SEED 9, STAR_COUNT 1800, SKY_DISTANCE 700: a SphereMesh of radius 0.7 with 4 sides and 2 rings, scaled 0.4 to 1.3, every direction), game/art/materials/star.tres (unshaded #eef2ff); hung here at 1900 m with each star as wide seen from the middle, past everything the stage holds and inside the views' 2000 m reach, as the game hangs them just inside its camera's reach; turned with the place's own axes, where the game turns them with the world's spin and the hour, which the record does not carry

dust.from: game/outside/dust/mars_wind.gd:17-52,190-220,294-312 (the calm day's drift: no wisps, DRIFT_GRAINS_CALM_SHARE 0.06 of DRIFT_GRAINS_A_CELL 20,000 grains on each 14 m cell, CELLS_OUT 2 so five by five cells round the player, DRIFT_HIGH_CALM 0.4 m, DRIFT_GRAIN_M 0.03, DRIFT_GRAIN_THICKNESS 0.7 faded in and out over each grain's life, three quarters on the whole), game/outside/dust/dust_grains.gd:24-38,106-117 (the unshaded speck in MARS_DUST #b4583a lifted by GRAIN_LIFT 1.25); the game's grains are thrown at random by the card each frame and follow the player, so the stage hangs one moment's worth at random from its own fixed seed over the 70 m square round the camp's middle, standing still

beams.name: mast_beam
beams.from: camp_mast.gd:11-23,26-45,121-145 (the beam: an open CylinderMesh of 8 sides, BEAM_WIDE_M 1.6 across, from the mast's top MAST_HEIGHT_M 12 to BEAM_HEIGHT_M 2,500 m over its foot along the mast's own up, never thinner than LEAST_HALF_ANGLE 0.0035 either side seen from the eye), camp_beam.gdshader (unshaded, added over what is behind it, both sides, Palette.CAMP_BEACON #74b9ea times GLOW 0.6), expedition_camp.gd:17,112,311 (the mast stands straight out from Mars at the camp seat's (10, -10)); its foot here the made mast's own (the foot of the column of campgrounds' mast_1 as this stage stands it through its `grounds` place, its column 12.0 m tall), its up straight out from Mars's middle under this frame (tools/usd/ground.py)

game_only: the cairn (held back for the ending), and the striped stand-in the game draws 1.4 m beside the boot rock only while its find is on show

the camp airlock's own look: the game draws the camp's airlock in the module shell's code look (white roof on struts, grey walls, dark red inside, boxes for its doors and locker), where the stage shows the Moon base's made airlock room of the same size in its place

the dust's life over time: the game blows the drift along round the player, sends its dust devils wandering the plain and brings a storm in and out with the weather; the stage carries the effects layer (data/effects/camp.json): the drift blowing along on the five by five cells round the camp's middle, two dust devils (grains and veil) standing about 21 and 32 m from the camp's middle where the outside cameras see them, and a dust storm as the variant weather = storm (the drift thick, fast and head high, no devils)
Mars's seeded rocks past the plan's square (they come from the run's world seed and lie past the stage's 130 m)

structure.name: camp_airlock_footing
structure.from: camp_airlock.gd:31-32,88-96 (the dark footing block, 3.6 by 2.8 m out from the room's middle and 1.2 m deep, in roof.tres)

planned_rocks.from: game/world/mars/mars.gd:59-77 (PLANNED_BOULDERS, PLANNED_STONES, PLANNED_PEBBLE 0.45, PLANNED_ROCKS_SEED 43, PLANNED_SUNK 0.12, PLANNED_TIP 0.25, PEBBLES_SEEN 40), mars.gd:371-411,438-449 (_planned_rocks and _planned_lying: every rock of the plan in its order, turned, tipped and stretched from the one seed, sunk by its own share of its height alone), game/world/ground/ground.gd:124-134 (PLAN_SIDE, PLAN_REACH 116, MARS_PLAN_LAYOUT); the game draws the plan's rocks out to 160 m from the eye, the stage those on the plan's square inside 116 m, where its heights have the whole say, and within 130 m of the place's middle
